items.title: Microsoft details how state-backed hackers use the ARTEX AI framework to automate cyberattacks
items.summary: Microsoft has published the technical architecture of ARTEX, an AI framework in wide use since July 2026 that runs cyberattacks with specialized agents and almost no human involvement. State-backed groups from China and North Korea, along with criminal organizations, are already using the system. items.title: Nvidia halts server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia after tighter US export controls
items.summary: Nvidia has told partners such as Dell and Supermicro to stop shipping servers to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia. Following new US export controls targeting Chinese cloud access, dealers are already seeking buyers for thousands of B300 chips, while one cloud executive describes "chaos", Loans and major deals are now on the line for Southeast Asia's data centers. items.title: US chip-access curbs and anti-distillation measures are reportedly already slowing Chinese AI labs
items.summary: Chip restrictions, anti-distillation measures, and shrinking access to Nvidia hardware abroad are putting growing pressure on Deepseek, Moonshot AI, and Alibaba, according to a report. Deepseek researchers internally estimate they're already up to nine months behind US models, and the gap is widening. items.title: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei says letting AI govern society would be "a bad idea"
items.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei is pushing back on an Axios report saying some employees believe humanity will hand power to superintelligent systems. items.title: OpenAI wants companies to trust it with sensitive work by promising not to look at their data
items.summary: OpenAI is testing a new feature called "Private Inference" that lets companies run queries on its most powerful models without OpenAI being able to access the data. items.title: Amazon and Meta are in talks to end the block on Meta's AI shopping agent Muse in Amazon's online store.
items.summary: Amazon and Meta are in talks to bring back Muse, Meta's AI shopping agent that Amazon kicked off its platform in September. The two sides are stuck on ad revenue and who gets to control search results. That matters because Amazon's ad business generates $68.6 billion a year, and Muse already commands 51 percent of all agentic shopping orders. items.title: AI agents now control part of Deepmind's compute for Gemini experiments, but recursive self-improvement remains distant
items.summary: Google Deepmind uses AI agents to run experiments on their own for upcoming Gemini models. Research chief Koray Kavukcuoglu says the lab is still far from recursive self-improvement. For oversight, Deepmind intentionally leaves the agents' internal chains of thought untrained so they can be reviewed. Kavukcuoglu measures AGI by everyday user trust rather than benchmarks. items.title: Anthropic study shows the hardest part of adopting AI at work has little to do with learning the tools
items.summary: Anthropic studied nearly 300 AI deployments across 58 US companies with sobering results. Nearly one in five still delivers no business value, held back by heavy review workloads, internal bottlenecks, and employee resistance. The researchers say the biggest hurdles stem from outdated company structures. items.title: Back-to-back cyber incidents at US financial investigators and spy agencies follow a string of federal hacks and outages
items.summary: The US Financial Crimes Enforcement Network took systems offline as a precaution after unauthorized access. Hours earlier, reports emerged of a separate breach at the CIA, NGA, and ODNI, in which investigators suspect attackers used the AI defense tool Artex.
